base_url.correction: No documented public API base URL; current public access is through https://www.redfin.com/news/data-center/downloads/

example.correction: Use the Data Center Download Hub to select filters and download CSV data; Redfin does not currently document the submitted fixed S3 TSV curl endpoint.

notes: Redfin relaunched the Data Center on May 12, 2026 with a unified data pipeline and a filtered-CSV download hub. The submitted /stingray base and legacy S3 TSV example are not part of the current official interface. Redfin publishes no API pricing, quotas, or CORS documentation, so those claims cannot be confirmed.
